ei.title: William Kamkwamba's Electric Wind & Remarkable Changes in Africa
ei.subject: 세계문화와영어비상

fullPassage: When Malawi was troubled with a famine, thousands of people starved and died. William's family also struggled financially and they were unable to pay the eighty-dollar-a-year tuition for William's education. He had to drop out of school. However, he did not stop holding his passion for technology and spent most of his time at the local library, where he discovered a book about windmills and renewable energy. Electricity and running water were luxuries that only two percent of Malawians could afford. William decided to build a windmill to generate electricity and started to collect scrap materials around his village. "People said I was crazy. They thought I was out of my mind. They crowded around me, curious about what I was making," said William. Even though many people in his community did not believe he could succeed, he eventually built a functioning windmill using old bicycle wheels, PVC pipes, and old tractor fan blades. His first windmill lit four light bulbs and the villagers lined up to charge their cell phones. He started making bigger windmills and provided enough power for lights at night. He also built a solar-powered water pump. This 'brought the rain' and helped the villagers fight against the drought and famine that came back every season. His achievement gained national and international attention, and he was invited to speak at various events and conferences to share his story and inspire others. He also received a full scholarship from Dartmouth College in the U.S. and completed environmental studies there. His story shows the power of creativity and determination, and is an inspiration for anyone who doubts the power of one individual's ability to change the community. William's story is just one example of the potential that exists in Africa. Despite facing numerous challenges like poverty, corruption, and political instability, Africa has seen a rapid growth in technology adoption, innovation, and entrepreneurship. With over 60% of Africans under the age of 25, the continent has a large pool of young individuals who are eager to innovate and create new businesses. From mobile money platforms to solar-powered irrigation systems, African innovators are finding new and innovative ways to address some of the continent's most pressing challenges, such as access to healthcare, education, and clean energy. Recently, mobile money platforms such as M-Pesa have emerged as a popular alternative to traditional banking. Mobile money has enabled millions of Africans to access financial services and has helped to drive economic growth and development. With abundant sunlight, companies like M-Kopa Solar brought affordable solar power to millions of households across the continent. E-commerce platforms such as Jumia and Konga are bringing the convenience of online shopping to African consumers, while agritech startups like FarmCrowdy are using technology to improve agricultural productivity and reduce food waste. Healthtech startups like mPharma are providing data analytics platform to make drugs more affordable for Africans. Overall, Africa's technological development is a promising sign for the continent's future. As more young people are educated and empowered to pursue careers in technology, and as governments and businesses invest in the continent's infrastructure and resources, Africa will continue to grow and thrive. With its rich cultural diversity, abundant natural resources, and thriving tech ecosystem, Africa is ready to play a vital role in technological innovation and progress in the years to come.

questions.passage: William's family also struggled financially and they were unable ①<u>to pay</u> the eighty-dollar-a-year tuition for William's education. He had to drop out of school. However, he did not stop holding his passion for technology and ②<u>spent</u> most of his time at the local library, ③<u>which</u> he discovered a book about windmills and renewable energy. Electricity and running water were luxuries that only two percent of Malawians could afford. William decided to build a windmill ④<u>to generate</u> electricity and started to collect scrap materials around his village.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ which → where: 장소 선행사 the local library를 받고 뒤 문장이 완전하므로 관계부사 where가 맞다
det.analysis:
① to pay: 'they were unable to pay the tuition'는 '그들은 학비를 낼 수 없었다'예요. 'be unable to+동사원형(~할 수 없다)' 구문이라 to pay가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

② spent: 'he did not stop holding his passion ~ and spent most of his time'는 '그는 열정을 버리지 않았고 대부분의 시간을 보냈다'예요. 앞의 과거동사와 and로 병렬 연결된 과거형이라 spent가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

③ which → 여기가 정답(틀린 곳)! 'the local library, ___ he discovered a book'은 '그가 책을 발견한 지역 도서관'이에요. 선행사가 장소(library)이고 뒤 문장(he discovered a book)이 빠진 성분 없이 완전하므로 관계부사 where를 써야 해요. which를 쓰면 뒤 문장에 목적어가 빠져 있어야 하는데 완전한 문장이라 틀려요. ❌ which는 틀림 ←정답

④ to generate: 'to build a windmill to generate electricity'는 '전기를 생산하기 위해 풍차를 만들다'예요. '~하기 위해'라는 목적을 나타내는 to부정사라 to generate가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름
det.tip: 완전한 문장 + 장소 선행사 → 관계부사 where (관계대명사 which는 뒤 문장에 빠진 성분이 있어야 한다)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① faced → facing: 전치사 Despite 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)가 와야 한다
det.analysis:
① faced → 여기가 정답(틀린 곳)! 'Despite ___ numerous challenges'는 '수많은 어려움에 직면함에도 불구하고'예요. Despite는 전치사라서 뒤에 명사나 동명사(-ing)가 와야 해요. 그래서 faced(과거형·과거분사)가 아니라 facing(직면하는 것)으로 써야 맞아요. ❌ faced는 틀림 ←정답

② who are: 'young individuals who are eager to innovate'는 '혁신을 열망하는 젊은이들'이에요. 선행사 individuals(복수)를 받는 주격 관계대명사라 복수 동사 are가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

③ have emerged: 'mobile money platforms ~ have emerged'는 '모바일 머니 플랫폼이 등장했다'예요. 주어 platforms(복수)에 맞춰 have를 썼고, 현재완료라 have emerged가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

④ has enabled: 'Mobile money has enabled millions'는 '모바일 머니가 수백만 명을 가능하게 했다'예요. 주어 Mobile money(단수)에 맞춰 has를 썼으니 has enabled가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름
det.tip: 전치사 Despite / In spite of 뒤에는 명사·동명사(-ing) — 절이나 과거분사는 올 수 없다

questions.passage: E-commerce platforms such as Jumia and Konga ①<u>are bringing</u> the convenience of online shopping to African consumers, while agritech startups like FarmCrowdy are using technology to improve agricultural productivity and reduce food waste. Healthtech startups like mPharma are providing data analytics platform ②<u>to make</u> drugs more affordable for Africans. Overall, Africa's technological development is a promising sign for the continent's future. As more young people ③<u>are educated</u> and empowered ④<u>pursuing</u> careers in technology, and as governments and businesses invest in the continent's infrastructure and resources, Africa will continue to grow and thrive. With its rich cultural diversity, abundant natural resources, and thriving tech ecosystem, Africa is ready to play a vital role in technological innovation and progress in the years to come.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ pursuing → to pursue: 'be empowered to+동사원형(~하도록 권한을 얻다)' 구문이다
det.analysis:
① are bringing: 'E-commerce platforms ~ are bringing the convenience'는 '전자상거래 플랫폼이 편리함을 가져다주고 있다'예요. 주어 platforms(복수)에 맞춘 현재진행이라 are bringing이 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

② to make: 'providing data analytics platform to make drugs more affordable'는 '약을 더 저렴하게 만들기 위해 데이터 분석 플랫폼을 제공한다'예요. '~하기 위해'라는 목적의 to부정사라 to make가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

③ are educated: 'As more young people are educated and empowered'는 '더 많은 젊은이가 교육받고 권한을 얻으면서'예요. 사람들이 '교육받는' 쪽이라 수동태 are educated가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

④ pursuing → 여기가 정답(틀린 곳)! '~ empowered to pursue careers in technology'는 '기술 분야에서 경력을 쌓도록 권한을 얻은'이에요. 'be empowered to+동사원형(~하도록 힘을 얻다)' 구문이라 to 뒤에는 동사원형 pursue가 와야 해요. pursuing(-ing)은 틀려요. ❌ pursuing은 틀림 ←정답
det.tip: empowered / allowed / encouraged + to+동사원형 — 뒤에 -ing를 쓰면 틀린다

questions.passage: Despite facing numerous challenges like poverty, corruption, and political instability, Africa has seen a ①<u>rapid</u> growth in technology adoption, innovation, and entrepreneurship. With over 60% of Africans under the age of 25, the continent has a large pool of young individuals who are eager to innovate and create new businesses. From mobile money platforms to solar-powered irrigation systems, African innovators are finding new and innovative ways to address some of the continent's most pressing challenges, such as access to healthcare, education, and clean energy. Recently, mobile money platforms such as M-Pesa have emerged as a ②<u>unpopular</u> alternative to traditional banking. Mobile money has ③<u>enabled</u> millions of Africans to access financial services and has helped to drive economic growth and development. With ④<u>abundant</u> sunlight, companies like M-Kopa Solar brought affordable solar power to millions of households across the continent. E-commerce platforms such as Jumia and Konga are bringing the convenience of online shopping to African consumers, while agritech startups like FarmCrowdy are using technology to improve agricultural productivity and reduce food waste. Healthtech startups like mPharma are providing data analytics platform to make drugs more affordable for Africans.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② unpopular → popular: 수백만 명이 이용했으니 '인기 있는' 대안이어야 한다
det.analysis:
① rapid(빠른): 'Africa has seen a rapid growth in technology'는 '아프리카가 기술에서 빠른 성장을 보였다'예요. 뒤에 혁신·창업 확대가 이어지니 '빠른(rapid)'이 자연스러워요. ✅ 적절

② unpopular → 여기가 정답(부적절한 곳)! 원문은 'M-Pesa have emerged as a popular alternative to traditional banking'로 '인기 있는 대안으로 떠올랐다'예요. 바로 뒤에 '수백만 명이 금융 서비스를 이용하게 되었다'라고 하니, 인기가 '많은(popular)' 대안이어야 해요. unpopular(인기 없는)로 바꾸면 앞뒤가 모순돼요. ❌ 부적절 ←정답

③ enabled(가능하게 했다): 'Mobile money has enabled millions of Africans to access financial services'는 '모바일 머니가 수백만 명이 금융 서비스를 이용하게 해 주었다'예요. 긍정적 결과를 말하니 '가능하게 했다(enabled)'가 맞아요. ✅ 적절

④ abundant(풍부한): 'With abundant sunlight, companies ~ brought affordable solar power'는 '풍부한 햇빛으로 저렴한 태양광 전력을 공급했다'예요. 태양광 사업의 배경이니 '풍부한 햇빛'이 자연스러워요. ✅ 적절
det.tip: 뒤에 '수백만 명이 이용'이 이어지므로 popular(인기 있는)가 문맥에 맞다

questions.passage: With abundant sunlight, companies like M-Kopa Solar brought ①<u>affordable</u> solar power to millions of households across the continent. E-commerce platforms such as Jumia and Konga are bringing the ②<u>convenience</u> of online shopping to African consumers, while agritech startups like FarmCrowdy are using technology to improve agricultural productivity and ③<u>increase</u> food waste. Healthtech startups like mPharma are providing data analytics platform to make drugs more affordable for Africans. Overall, Africa's technological development is a ④<u>promising</u> sign for the continent's future. As more young people are educated and empowered to pursue careers in technology, and as governments and businesses invest in the continent's infrastructure and resources, Africa will continue to grow and thrive. With its rich cultural diversity, abundant natural resources, and thriving tech ecosystem, Africa is ready to play a vital role in technological innovation and progress in the years to come.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ increase → reduce: 생산성을 높이면 음식물 쓰레기는 '줄여야' 문맥이 맞다
det.analysis:
① affordable(저렴한): 'brought affordable solar power to millions of households'는 '수백만 가구에 저렴한 태양광 전력을 공급했다'예요. 널리 보급했다는 긍정 흐름이라 '저렴한(affordable)'이 맞아요. ✅ 적절

② convenience(편리함): 'bringing the convenience of online shopping to African consumers'는 '아프리카 소비자에게 온라인 쇼핑의 편리함을 가져다준다'예요. 전자상거래의 장점을 말하니 '편리함'이 자연스러워요. ✅ 적절

③ increase → 여기가 정답(부적절한 곳)! 원문은 'improve agricultural productivity and reduce food waste'로 '농업 생산성을 높이고 음식물 쓰레기를 줄인다'예요. 기술로 좋아지는 흐름이라 쓰레기는 '줄여야(reduce)' 해요. increase(늘리다)로 바꾸면 '쓰레기를 늘린다'가 되어 앞의 '생산성 향상'과 모순돼요. ❌ 부적절 ←정답

④ promising(유망한): 'Africa's technological development is a promising sign for the continent's future'는 '아프리카의 기술 발전은 대륙의 미래에 유망한 신호다'예요. 글 전체의 낙관적 결론이라 '유망한(promising)'이 맞아요. ✅ 적절
det.tip: '생산성을 높이다'와 짝이 되는 긍정적 행동 = reduce food waste(쓰레기를 줄이다)

E-commerce platforms such as Jumia and Konga are bringing the convenience of online shopping to African consumers, while agritech startups like FarmCrowdy are using technology to improve agricultural productivity and reduce food waste. Healthtech startups like mPharma are providing data analytics platform to make drugs more affordable for Africans. Overall, Africa's technological development is a promising sign for the continent's future.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① financial services(금융 서비스): 은행 대안으로 등장한 모바일 머니가 제공하는 것
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장: 'Mobile money has enabled millions of Africans to access ___ and has helped to drive economic growth'(모바일 머니는 수백만 명의 아프리카인이 ___에 접근하게 해 주었고 경제 성장을 이끌었다). 바로 앞 문장에서 모바일 머니가 '전통 은행업의 대안(alternative to traditional banking)'으로 떠올랐다고 했으니, 빈칸은 은행이 다루는 것이어야 해요.

✅ ① financial services(금융 서비스): 은행 대안이 제공하는 것이라 딱 맞아요. ←정답

❌ ② clean drinking water(깨끗한 식수): 물 문제는 앞부분 윌리엄 이야기이고, 모바일 머니와는 관련이 없어요.

❌ ③ free public education(무상 공교육): 교육은 다른 문장에서 언급될 뿐, 모바일 머니가 주는 것이 아니에요.

❌ ④ foreign aid(외국 원조): 원조 이야기는 글에 없어요. 모바일 머니는 원조가 아니라 금융 접근을 준 거예요.
det.tip: alternative to traditional banking(은행의 대안) → 은행이 주는 financial services(금융 서비스)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ④ a rapid growth(빠른 성장): 어려움에도 기술 도입·혁신·창업이 크게 늘었다
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장: 'Africa has seen ___ in technology adoption, innovation, and entrepreneurship'(아프리카는 기술 도입, 혁신, 창업에서 ___을 보였다). 뒤 문장들에서 청년 인구가 많고, 모바일 머니·전자상거래·헬스테크가 확산된다고 하니, 빈칸은 '크게 늘었다'는 긍정적 변화여야 해요.

❌ ① a serious shortage(심각한 부족): 기술이 늘어난다는 흐름과 정반대예요.

❌ ② a sharp decline(급격한 감소): 성장 이야기와 반대라 안 맞아요.

❌ ③ a long delay(오랜 지연): 발전이 지체되었다는 뜻이라 글의 낙관적 흐름과 어긋나요.

✅ ④ a rapid growth(빠른 성장): 기술 도입·혁신·창업이 빠르게 늘었다는 뜻이라 딱 맞아요. ←정답
det.tip: 뒤에 이어지는 청년층·모바일 머니·전자상거래 확산 = a rapid growth(빠른 성장)의 근거

questions.passage: When Malawi was troubled with a famine, thousands of people starved and died. William's family also struggled financially and they were unable to pay the eighty-dollar-a-year tuition for William's education. He had to drop out of school. However, he did not stop holding his passion for technology and spent most of his time at the local library, where he discovered a book about windmills and renewable energy. Electricity and running water were luxuries that only two percent of Malawians could afford.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ② 원문: When Malawi was troubled with a famine, thousands of people starved and died
det.analysis:
✅ ② 원문 'When Malawi was troubled with a famine, thousands of people starved and died'를 그대로 옮긴 거예요. '기근으로 수천 명이 굶주려 사망했다' = 일치. ←정답

❌ ① 원문은 'they were unable to pay the eighty-dollar-a-year tuition'(학비를 낼 수 없었다)이라, '아무 어려움 없이 낼 수 있었다'는 정반대예요.

❌ ③ 원문은 'He had to drop out of school'(학교를 그만둬야 했다)이라, '끝까지 다녔다'는 틀려요.

❌ ④ 원문은 'luxuries that only two percent of Malawians could afford'(2%만 누릴 수 있던 사치품)이라, '대부분이 누렸다'는 틀려요.
det.tip: 함정: drop out of school(학교를 그만두다), only two percent(오직 2%) — 원문 수치·행동을 뒤집은 오답을 걸러라

ch: 윌리엄의 가족은 학비를 아무 어려움 없이 낼 수 있었다.
말라위의 기근으로 수천 명이 굶주려 목숨을 잃었다.
윌리엄은 학교를 그만두지 않고 끝까지 다녔다.
전기와 수돗물은 말라위 국민 대부분이 누리는 것이었다.

questions.passage: Even though many people in his community did not believe he could succeed, he eventually built a functioning windmill using old bicycle wheels, PVC pipes, and old tractor fan blades. His first windmill lit four light bulbs and the villagers lined up to charge their cell phones. He started making bigger windmills and provided enough power for lights at night. His achievement gained national and international attention, and he was invited to speak at various events and conferences to share his story and inspire others.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ③ 원문: He also built a solar-powered water pump — 물 펌프도 성공적으로 만들었다
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 여기가 정답(일치하지 않는 것)! 원문은 'He also built a solar-powered water pump'로 '그는 태양광 물 펌프도 만들었다'예요. 성공적으로 만들었으므로 '끝내 실패했다'는 사실과 반대예요. ←정답

❌ ① 원문 'he eventually built a functioning windmill using old bicycle wheels, PVC pipes, and old tractor fan blades'와 일치해요.

❌ ② 원문 'His first windmill lit four light bulbs and the villagers lined up to charge their cell phones'와 일치해요.

❌ ④ 원문 'His achievement gained national and international attention'과 일치해요.
det.tip: 함정: built a solar-powered water pump(물 펌프를 만들었다) — '실패했다'로 뒤집은 오답을 잡아라

ch: 윌리엄은 낡은 자전거 바퀴와 PVC 파이프 등으로 작동하는 풍차를 만들었다.
첫 풍차는 네 개의 전구를 밝혔고 마을 사람들이 휴대폰을 충전하러 줄을 섰다.
윌리엄은 태양광 물 펌프를 만드는 데는 끝내 실패했다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ① 원문: With over 60% of Africans under the age of 25
det.analysis:
✅ ① 원문 'With over 60% of Africans under the age of 25, the continent has a large pool of young individuals'를 옮긴 거예요. '60% 이상이 25세 미만' = 일치. ←정답

❌ ② 원문은 'have emerged as a popular alternative to traditional banking'(전통 은행업의 인기 있는 대안으로 떠올랐다)이라, '완전히 사라지게 만들었다'는 과장·왜곡이에요. 대안일 뿐 은행을 없앤 게 아니에요.

❌ ③ 원문은 'brought affordable solar power to millions of households'(수백만 가구에 저렴한 태양광 전력을 공급했다)이라, '소수 부유층에게만'은 반대예요.

❌ ④ 원문은 'using technology to improve agricultural productivity'(농업 생산성을 높이기 위해 기술을 사용한다)이라, '떨어뜨렸다'는 정반대예요.
det.tip: 핵심: 60% 이상 25세 미만(청년층) / 모바일 머니=대안(은행 소멸 아님) / 태양광=수백만 가구 / agritech=생산성 향상

ch: 모바일 머니 플랫폼은 전통 은행업을 완전히 사라지게 만들었다.
M-Kopa Solar는 태양광 전력을 소수 부유층에게만 공급했다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ④ how innovation and technology are driving remarkable change in Africa(혁신과 기술이 아프리카에 놀라운 변화를 이끄는 방식)
det.analysis:
글은 윌리엄의 풍차 발명을 하나의 예로 들며, 아프리카가 청년층·모바일 머니·태양광·전자상거래·헬스테크를 통해 빠르게 발전하고 있음을 설명해요.

❌ ① the difficulty of building windmills only from scrap materials(고물로만 풍차를 만드는 일의 어려움): 풍차는 도입부의 한 예시일 뿐, 글 전체의 중심이 아니에요.

❌ ② the history of traditional banking systems across Africa(아프리카 전통 은행 시스템의 역사): 전통 은행은 모바일 머니의 대비로 잠깐 언급될 뿐이에요.

❌ ③ reasons why young Africans move abroad to study(아프리카 청년들이 유학을 떠나는 이유): 유학 이야기는 글의 주제가 아니에요.

✅ ④ how innovation and technology are driving remarkable change in Africa(혁신과 기술이 아프리카에 놀라운 변화를 이끄는 방식): 윌리엄의 사례와 아프리카 전역의 기술 발전을 아우르는 주제예요. ←정답
det.tip: 핵심어 innovation / technology / growth = 기술과 혁신이 아프리카를 바꾸는 이야기

ch: the difficulty of building windmills only from scrap materials

questions.stem: 다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② From One Windmill to a Continent of Innovation(풍차 하나에서 혁신의 대륙으로)
det.analysis:

❌ ③ Why Solar Power Failed in Rural Africa(시골 아프리카에서 태양광이 실패한 이유): 태양광은 오히려 성공 사례로 나오니 정반대예요.

From One Windmill to a Continent of Innovation

questions.passage: Even though many people in his community did not believe he could succeed, he eventually built a functioning windmill using old bicycle wheels, PVC pipes, and old tractor fan blades. His first windmill lit four light bulbs and the villagers lined up to charge their cell phones. He started making bigger windmills and provided enough power for lights at night. He also built a solar-powered water pump. This '<u>brought the rain</u>' and helped the villagers fight against the drought and famine that came back every season.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 brought the rain이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ provided a solution that relieved the village's water shortage(마을의 물 부족을 해소한 해결책을 제공했다)
det.analysis:
밑줄 표현이 있는 문장은 'He also built a solar-powered water pump. This ˇbrought the rainˇ and helped the villagers fight against the drought and famine'이에요. 태양광 물 펌프가 물을 끌어와 가뭄·기근과 싸우게 도왔다는 맥락이니, '비를 가져왔다'는 실제 비가 아니라 '물 부족 문제를 해결했다'는 비유예요.

❌ ① predicted the exact weather for the coming season(다가올 계절 날씨를 정확히 예측했다): 날씨 예측 이야기는 없어요.

❌ ② forced the villagers to leave their homes(마을 사람들을 떠나게 만들었다): 오히려 마을을 도운 것이라 반대예요.

✅ ③ provided a solution that relieved the village's water shortage(마을의 물 부족을 해소한 해결책을 제공했다): 물 펌프가 가뭄 문제를 풀어 주었다는 뜻 그대로예요. ←정답

❌ ④ made the drought and famine much worse than before(가뭄과 기근을 더 악화시켰다): 문제를 해결한 것이므로 정반대예요.
det.tip: brought the rain(비를 가져왔다) = 물 부족·가뭄 문제를 해결했다는 비유

ch: predicted the exact weather for the coming season
forced the villagers to leave their homes
provided a solution that relieved the village's water shortage
made the drought and famine much worse than before

questions.passage: When Malawi was troubled with a famine, thousands of people starved and died. William's family also struggled financially and <u>they</u> were unable to pay the eighty-dollar-a-year tuition for William's education. He had to drop out of school. However, he did not stop holding his passion for technology and spent most of his time at the local library, where he discovered a book about windmills and renewable energy. Electricity and running water were luxuries that only two percent of Malawians could afford.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 they가 가리키는 대상으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① they = William's family (윌리엄의 가족)
det.analysis:
밑줄 문장은 'William's family also struggled financially and ˇtheyˇ were unable to pay the tuition'이에요. '윌리엄의 가족도 경제적으로 어려웠고 그들은 학비를 낼 수 없었다'라는 뜻이라, they는 바로 앞의 주어인 'William's family(윌리엄의 가족)'를 가리켜요.

✅ ① 윌리엄의 가족: 학비를 낼 수 없었던 주체가 바로 가족이에요. ←정답

❌ ② 말라위의 모든 국민: 기근으로 고생한 것은 많은 사람이지만, 이 문장에서 학비를 못 낸 주체는 '가족'이에요.

❌ ③ 지역 도서관의 사서들: 도서관은 뒤 문장에 나오고, they와 무관해요.

❌ ④ 풍차를 함께 만든 기술자들: 풍차는 훨씬 뒤 이야기이고, 이 문장의 they와 관계없어요.
det.tip: they 바로 앞 주어 William's family(윌리엄의 가족)가 가리키는 대상이다

questions.passage: From mobile money platforms to solar-powered irrigation systems, African innovators are finding new and innovative ways to address some of the continent's most __________, such as access to healthcare, education, and clean energy. Recently, mobile money platforms such as M-Pesa have emerged as a popular alternative to traditional banking. Mobile money has enabled millions of Africans to access financial services and has helped to drive economic growth and development. With abundant sunlight, companies like M-Kopa Solar brought affordable solar power to millions of households across the continent. E-commerce platforms such as Jumia and Konga are bringing the convenience of online shopping to African consumers, while agritech startups like FarmCrowdy are using technology to improve agricultural productivity and reduce food waste.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ④ pressing challenges(시급한 문제들): 의료·교육·에너지 접근 같은 시급한 과제를 해결한다
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장: 'African innovators are finding new and innovative ways to address some of the continent's most ___, such as access to healthcare, education, and clean energy'(아프리카 혁신가들은 대륙의 가장 큰 ___을 해결할 새로운 방법을 찾고 있는데, 예를 들어 의료·교육·청정에너지 접근이다). 뒤에 '의료·교육·에너지 접근'이라는 해결해야 할 과제가 예로 나오니, 빈칸은 '해결해야 할 문제'여야 해요.

❌ ① daily routines(일상적인 일과): 의료·교육 접근은 일과가 아니라 사회적 과제예요.

❌ ② family secrets(집안의 비밀): 문맥과 전혀 관계없어요.

❌ ③ tourist attractions(관광 명소): 해결 대상이 아니라 볼거리라 안 맞아요.

✅ ④ pressing challenges(시급한 문제들): 의료·교육·에너지 접근처럼 반드시 풀어야 할 과제를 뜻해 딱 맞아요. ←정답
det.tip: such as access to healthcare, education(예: 의료·교육 접근) = 해결해야 할 pressing challenges(시급한 문제들)

questions.passage: From mobile money platforms to solar-powered irrigation systems, __________ to address some of the continent's most pressing challenges, such as access to healthcare, education, and clean energy. Recently, mobile money platforms such as M-Pesa have emerged as a popular alternative to traditional banking. Mobile money has enabled millions of Africans to access financial services and has helped to drive economic growth and development. With abundant sunlight, companies like M-Kopa Solar brought affordable solar power to millions of households across the continent. E-commerce platforms such as Jumia and Konga are bringing the convenience of online shopping to African consumers, while agritech startups like FarmCrowdy are using technology to improve agricultural productivity and reduce food waste. Healthtech startups like mPharma are providing data analytics platform to make drugs more affordable for Africans.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말 뜻에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

"아프리카의 혁신가들은 새롭고 혁신적인 방법을 찾고 있다." (8단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) African, and, are, finding, innovative, innovators, new, ways 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: African innovators are finding new and innovative ways
det.analysis:
우리말 '아프리카의 혁신가들'이 주어예요. African(아프리카의) + innovators(혁신가들) → 'African innovators'라는 주어를 만들어요.

'(지금) 찾고 있다'처럼 진행 중인 일은 'be동사 + -ing(현재진행)'로 나타내요. 주어가 복수라서 be동사는 are를 쓰고 뒤에 finding을 붙여 'are finding(찾고 있다)'이 돼요.

마지막으로 '새롭고 혁신적인 방법'은 new(새로운) + and(그리고) + innovative(혁신적인) + ways(방법) → 'new and innovative ways'로 놓아요.

순서대로 이으면 African / innovators / are / finding / new / and / innovative / ways 가 돼요.
det.tip: 현재진행 be동사(are) + -ing(finding) / 두 형용사를 and로 연결 = new and innovative ways

questions.wa: African innovators are finding new and innovative ways
accept: African innovators are finding new and innovative ways

questions.passage: E-commerce platforms such as Jumia and Konga are bringing the convenience of online shopping to African consumers. At the same time, agritech startups like FarmCrowdy are __________ (use) technology to improve agricultural productivity and reduce food waste.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 흐름에 맞도록 괄호 안에 주어진 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: use → using (be동사 뒤 현재진행형 -ing)
det.analysis:
구문 분석: 빈칸이 있는 문장은 'agritech startups ~ are ___ technology to improve productivity'예요. '스타트업들이 기술을 사용하고 있다'라는 뜻으로, 주어 startups(복수) 뒤에 be동사 are가 이미 있어요.

be동사(are) 뒤에서 '(지금) ~하고 있다'라는 현재진행형을 만들려면 동사에 -ing를 붙여야 해요. 그래서 use는 using으로 바꿔 'are using(사용하고 있다)'이 돼요.

앞 문장의 'are bringing'과 같은 현재진행 구조라는 점에서도 using이 맞다는 것을 알 수 있어요.
det.tip: be동사(are) + 동사원형-ing = 현재진행형 → use는 using

questions.passage: With over 60% of Africans under the age of 25, the continent has a large pool of __________ and create new businesses. From mobile money platforms to solar-powered irrigation systems, African innovators are finding new and innovative ways to address some of the continent's most pressing challenges, such as access to healthcare, education, and clean energy. Recently, mobile money platforms such as M-Pesa have emerged as a popular alternative to traditional banking. Mobile money has enabled millions of Africans to access financial services and has helped to drive economic growth and development. With abundant sunlight, companies like M-Kopa Solar brought affordable solar power to millions of households across the continent.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말 뜻에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

"혁신하기를 열망하는 젊은 사람들" (7단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) are, eager, individuals, innovate, to, who, young 을 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 7단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: young individuals who are eager to innovate
det.analysis:
먼저 꾸밈을 받는 핵심 명사구 '젊은 사람들'을 만들어요: young(젊은) + individuals(사람들) → 'young individuals'.

'혁신하기를 열망하는'이라는 설명은 관계대명사 who로 연결해요. individuals가 복수라서 be동사는 are를 쓰고, 'be eager to+동사원형(~하기를 열망하다)' 구문을 써서 'who are eager to innovate(혁신하기를 열망하는)'가 돼요.

순서대로 이으면 young / individuals / who / are / eager / to / innovate 가 돼요.
det.tip: 명사(individuals) 뒤에 who로 설명을 붙이고, be eager to+동사원형(~하기를 열망하다)을 사용

questions.passage: With abundant sunlight, __________ to millions of households across the continent. Healthtech startups like mPharma are providing data analytics platform to make drugs more affordable for Africans. questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오.
"M-Kopa Solar와 같은 회사들이 저렴한 태양광 전력을 공급했다."

[ affordable / brought / companies / like / M-Kopa / power / Solar / solar ] (8단어) (영어로)

det.korean: companies like M-Kopa Solar brought affordable solar power
det.analysis:
우리말 '~와 같은 회사들이 ~을 공급했다'를 영어 어순으로 배열하는 문제예요.

먼저 주어 '회사들'을 놓고, '~와 같은'은 like로 예를 들어요: companies(회사들) + like(~와 같은) + M-Kopa Solar → 'companies like M-Kopa Solar'.

동사는 '공급했다'라는 과거형 brought(가져다주었다)를 써요.

마지막으로 목적어 '저렴한 태양광 전력'은 affordable(저렴한) + solar(태양의) + power(전력) → 'affordable solar power'로 놓아요.

순서대로 이으면 companies / like / M-Kopa / Solar / brought / affordable / solar / power 가 돼요.
det.tip: companies like ~ = ~와 같은 회사들 / brought(bring의 과거) = 가져다주었다, 공급했다

questions.wa: companies like M-Kopa Solar brought affordable solar power
accept: companies like M-Kopa Solar brought affordable solar power

questions.passage: Overall, Africa's technological development is a promising sign for the continent's future. As more young people are educated and empowered to pursue careers in technology, and as governments and businesses invest in the continent's infrastructure and resources, Africa will continue to grow and thrive. With its rich cultural diversity, abundant natural resources, and thriving tech ecosystem, __________ in technological innovation and progress in the years to come.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말 뜻에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

"아프리카는 중요한 역할을 할 준비가 되어 있다." (8단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) a, Africa, is, play, ready, role, to, vital 을 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: Africa is ready to play a vital role
det.analysis:
우리말 '아프리카는 ~할 준비가 되어 있다'가 핵심이라, 주어 Africa로 시작해요.

'~할 준비가 되어 있다'는 'be ready to+동사원형' 구문으로 나타내요. 주어가 단수라 be동사는 is를 쓰고, 'is ready to play(할 준비가 되어 있다)'가 돼요.

마지막으로 '중요한 역할'은 관사 a + vital(중요한) + role(역할) → 'a vital role'로 놓아요.

순서대로 이으면 Africa / is / ready / to / play / a / vital / role 이 돼요.
det.tip: be ready to+동사원형 = ~할 준비가 되어 있다 → is ready to play

questions.wa: Africa is ready to play a vital role
accept: Africa is ready to play a vital role
